Problem

`McpTaskStoreTests.CancelTaskAsync_ViaStore_TransitionsToCancelled` runs `slow-tool` as a task and then cancels it, but `slow-tool` finishes by itself after 200 ms. If the tool finishes before the `tasks/cancel` handler marks the task cancelled, the task stays completed, because `InMemoryMcpTaskStore.SetCancelledAsync` does not change a finished task. `tasks/get` then returns `CompletedTaskResult` and the test fails:

> Assert.IsType() Failure: Value is not the exact type
> Expected: typeof(ModelContextProtocol.Extensions.Tasks.CancelledTaskResult)
> Actual:   typeof(ModelContextProtocol.Extensions.Tasks.CompletedTaskResult)

This happened in [build (windows-latest, Debug)](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/actions/runs/39976544742/job/120528606965) on .NET 9 for #1856, which does not touch Tasks; attempt 3 of that job passed. In the test log the server starts the `tasks/cancel` handler, then logs `"slow-tool" completed. IsError = False.`, then finishes the handler after 250 ms.

## Change

- Add `long-running-tool` to `TaskStoreTestTools`. It waits on `Task.Delay(Timeout.Infinite, cancellationToken)`, like the tool in `TaskCancellationIntegrationTests`.
- `CancelTaskAsync_ViaStore_TransitionsToCancelled` uses it, so the task can only end through `tasks/cancel`. The cancel handler marks the task cancelled before it cancels the tool's token, so the tool stops and the task stays cancelled. If `tasks/cancel` arrives before the tool starts, the tool gets an already-cancelled token and the task still ends cancelled.
- `slow-tool` is unchanged. Two other tests still use it, and `CallToolAsync_WithTaskStore_PollsToCompletion` needs it to finish.

## Validation

Built `tests/ModelContextProtocol.Tests` for net10.0, net9.0, net8.0 (Debug) and net472 (Release) with 0 warnings, then ran the tests with vstest, for example:

```
vstest.console.exe artifacts\bin\ModelContextProtocol.Tests\Debug\net10.0\ModelContextProtocol.Tests.dll /TestCaseFilter:"FullyQualifiedName=ModelContextProtocol.Tests.Server.McpTaskStoreTests.CancelTaskAsync_ViaStore_TransitionsToCancelled"
```

- Before/after: with a local-only `await Task.Delay(1000, ct);` before `CancelTaskAsync` (not in this PR), the test failed 10 of 10 times on `main` with the CI message, and passed 10 of 10 times with this change (.NET 10).
- Without that delay: 20/20 passed on .NET 10, 20/20 on .NET 9, and 10/10 on .NET 10 with all 16 logical CPUs held at 100% by busy loops.
- `FullyQualifiedName~McpTaskStoreTests|FullyQualifiedName~TaskCancellationIntegrationTests` (58 tests, including `InMemoryMcpTaskStoreTests`): all passed on .NET 10, 9 and 8. On .NET Framework on Windows, `McpTaskStoreTests` and `TaskCancellationIntegrationTests` are skipped (#587).
- Full `ModelContextProtocol.Tests` with `Execution!=Manual` (the CI filter): 0 failed on .NET 10 and on .NET Framework 4.7.2.
